selection: One 20-second window per ego: earliest stable mainline lane change centered when feasible, otherwise midpoint of longest continuous eligible segment. Keep all accepted candidates in CSV; materialize a deterministic uniform hash-ranked sample per split/class. No safety-outcome filtering, no smoothing. Version 2 adds up to 70 non-overlapping clips per split and class beyond v1; the combined catalogue therefore reaches at most 100 per stratum where eligible candidates permit.
evaluation: Class-stratified sample; report per-class and candidate-count weighted aggregate. Test is cross-site OOD, not IID. Adjacent recordings within the same split may share traffic; use recording/time-block clusters, not independent-frame confidence intervals.
